stage0050b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「You don't seem hurt.
　You ran right out in front of a car,
　so it gave me quite a scare.」

stage0050b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$n
「We got swept up in a $$時空震動$$
　over the Pacific, and...」

stage0050b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$n
「You don't know what a $$時空震動$$ is...!?」

stage0050b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「For now, let me answer your question.
　This city is called Paradigm City.」

stage0050b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Indeed, that's right.
　And this city has lost its memory too.」

stage0050b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Miss, please leave this to me.
　I'll see to his injuries.」

stage0050b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「I do apologize.
　Might I leave it to you, then?」

stage0050b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Of course.
　That is my role, after all.」

stage0050b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「I am $$ノーマン・バーグ$$.
　Allow me to welcome you.」

stage0050b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text: ～ Paradigm City, Paradigm Corp. President's Office ～

stage0050b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$モーム$$
「...Master $$桂$$... just where is this...?」

stage0050b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$桂$$
「I don't know either.
　We got hit by a $$時空震動$$, and when
　I came to, it was some strange street corner.」

stage0050b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$モーム$$
「This city seems to be called Paradigm City...」

stage0050b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$桂$$
「Feels like I might've heard it before, or not...」

stage0050b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ベック$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting.
　I'm the president of this Paradigm Corp.,
　$$ジェイソン・ベック$$.」

stage0050b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$桂$$
「N-no... I'm not sure, but,
　have you met us before?」

stage0050b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ベック$$
「No... this should be our first meeting...」

stage0050b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$モーム$$
「Then why did you invite us
　to such a fancy office?」

stage0050b_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ベック$$
「Guests, if I may call you that for now,
　you don't seem to live in this city.」

stage0050b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ベック$$
「It's rare for anyone from outside
　to come to this city, so I wanted to
　hear all about it.」

stage0050b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$桂$$
「Rare for people to come here...
　is this city stuck in some rift between worlds?」

stage0050b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ベック$$
「A rift between worlds...?
　What an interesting thing to say.」

stage0050b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ベック$$
「Surely you already know?
　What lies outside this Paradigm City.」

stage0050b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ベック$$
「Truly interesting people, you are.
　Though we don't know why it's like that
　out there either.」

stage0050b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ベック$$
「After all, this is a city that's lost
　its memory... its memories, so to speak.」

stage0050b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't know...
　It looks like the aftermath of some disaster...」

stage0050b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And this bitter cold in the air...
　It's as if the sun's light no longer reaches here.」

stage0050b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this related to what that
　$$アドヴェント$$ person called history's end...?」

stage0050b_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Faced with a sight like this, it's only natural.」

stage0050b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, let's head for that dome first.
　It looks like people are there.」

stage0050b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Right.
　If only we could link up
　with everyone from $c too...」

stage0050b_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「What in the world is this place...」

stage0050b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「All we know is that
　this city's called Paradigm City...」

stage0050b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$シモン$$
「And that the people here
　don't have memories from 40 years ago?」

stage0050b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アルト$$
「What's that supposed to mean...!?
　Is everyone just fine with that!?」

stage0050b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Who knows.
　At least they seem used to it by now.」

stage0050b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We were thrown into this city by a $$時空震動$$.」

stage0050b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$刹那$$
「Is this... that man $$アドヴェント$$'s trap...?」

stage0050b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「If so, that man possesses power beyond
　anything we could possibly imagine...」

stage0050b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「We've made contact with the Quarter
　and the other ships. They're near the port.」

stage0050b_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「We're currently in contact with an organization
　called the Military Police, explaining things.」

stage0050b_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アルト$$
「Did you find out where this place is?」

stage0050b_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Apparently GPS and every other positioning
　system has lost track of our location.」

stage0050b_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
「So we really got thrown into another world...?」

stage0050b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... conned by one hell of a swindler...!」

stage0050b_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So saving $n in Orb
　was just to make us let our guard down.」

stage0050b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$刹那$$
「It's too soon to conclude that.
　Let's gather information for now.」

stage0050b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah.
　Let's ask a few more people in town.」

stage0050b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... I meant, aren't you shocked
　getting caught up in something like this...」

stage0050b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This time it's less that I got caught up,
　more that I said I wanted to come myself.
　I'm not about to get mad or mope over it.」

stage0050b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「More importantly, if this is tied to
　humanity's end, we need to find some clue.」

stage0050b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Pathetic, $$宗介$$.
　You're supposed to be watching her back,
　and instead she's the one cheering you up.」

stage0050b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「...I can't argue with that this time.」

stage0050b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about it, don't worry about it.
　Let's get moving instead of resting.」

stage0050b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I, I'm sorry!
　I wasn't watching where I was going...」

stage0050b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$宗介$$
「Get back, Chidori...!
　Something's wrong with him!」

stage0050b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Look closely.
　That's a squashed tomato.」

stage0050b_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Just who... in the world am I...」

stage0050b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「If that's the case,
　every resident of this city has amnesia.」

stage0050b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$刹那$$
「But that man hadn't come to terms with it.
　So he only lost his memory recently?」

stage0050b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Then, could it be...!
　That person was thrown here
　just like us, wasn't he!?」

stage0050b_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$宗介$$
「What's wrong...?
　Is that man bothering you?」

stage0050b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Something about him just doesn't sit right...」

stage0050b_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アルト$$
「What is this...
　this feeling of deja vu...」

stage0050b_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「At times like this, acting on instinct
　is the right call. Let's follow him.」

stage0050b_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「So, they've met after all...」

stage0050b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Is this fate...?
　If so, then he will again...」

stage0050b_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$n
「...So, Mr. $$ノーマン$$ has
　taken in people from outside the city
　before, then?」

stage0050b_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Yes...
　A small part of that memory still remains within me.」

stage0050b_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$n
「So the people of this city live their lives
　following those faint remaining memories.」

stage0050b_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Indeed.
　It seems my memory is that of a butler,
　a role of looking after someone.」

stage0050b_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$n
「I'm not quite sure, but
　meeting someone from outside the city before,
　that was 40 years ago, right?」

stage0050b_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Given how faintly it remains in my memory,
　I suppose that must be so.」

stage0050b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「Then, was Mr. $$ノーマン$$ around
　his twenties back then?」

stage0050b_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「No...
　I seem to have been about this same age.」

stage0050b_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「So you're saying Mr. $$ノーマン$$ hasn't aged at all?」

stage0050b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Master $n's doubts are quite natural.
　But so long as we live in this city,
　we've come to accept it as a given」

stage0050b_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Perhaps this city has lost not only
　its memories, but the flow of time itself」

stage0050b_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$n
「A city that lost the flow of time...」

stage0050b_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
「That one... is close by... so close...」

stage0050b_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Who do you mean, 'that one'?」

stage0050b_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（When they showed up at Crosspoint,
　I'll admit I panicked. But maybe it's for the best...）

stage0050b_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（If I get too lazy about this,
　little $$アンナロッタ$$'s gonna hate me for real）

stage0050b_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（...The flow of time... that is...）

stage0050b_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（Soon, it'll come to this...）

stage0050b_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（And then, in the end...）

stage0050b_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, you've come, mister.
　Drinking on someone else's tab
　every day sure takes some nerve」

stage0050b_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
？？？
「My apologies, I'm not the one you're waiting for」

stage0050b_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Looks like you've noticed.
　That's right... the one piloting
　that $$アスクレプス$$ is me」

stage0050b_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「My name is $$アドヴェント$$.
　One who watches over humanity's evolution」

stage0050b_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My, my... quite the grand title.
　So, what is it?
　Did you come today for a drink with me?」

stage0050b_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.
　Let me buy the next round」

stage0050b_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well, this is a surprise...!
　So you know my name too」

stage0050b_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「My organization has its own decent network」

stage0050b_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「An organization, is it...
　watchers over humanity's evolution, then?」

stage0050b_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Seems like you...
　are humans who branched off from them...」

stage0050b_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$ガドライト$$.
　Today is the first and last time we'll talk like this」

stage0050b_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let me declare it here.
　Your plan, $c and I will be the ones
　to stop it without fail」

stage0050b_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's all I have to say」

stage0050b_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...What a hasty fellow.
　I appreciate the drink, but as a
　courtesy, at least join me for a toast」

stage0050b_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But I do welcome a bit of excitement...」

stage0050b_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This tedious watchdog duty of mine
　just got a whole lot more interesting」

stage0050b_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies.
　I have somewhere to be today,
　so please make this transaction quick」

stage0050b_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With that said,
　I'll skip the sales pitch today」

stage0050b_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's get fired up today too... business!」
